entries.zh: 静思默想；凝神观想（天主教灵修用语：心中专注地思念、默想天主之事）
entries.en: to contemplate; to meditate attentively (spiritual meditation in the missionary sense)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语词头仍为 Contemplar，汉字与注音各栏均空缺）
entries.en: illegible/blank entry; headword Contemplar, remaining columns empty
entries.notes: 三栏 [空]，仅词头可断为「凝思」义，无从互证。

entries.zh: 尖嘴；以好言巧语敷衍应付（用甜言蜜语圆滑周旋）
entries.en: pointed/sharp mouth; to parley with fair words, to temporize with pleasant speech
entries.notes: 汉字「尖嘴」与西语「用好话敷衍」的关联依赖推断（尖嘴利舌→巧言应对），音写 chiam chùi 清晰但 T99 污损。

entries.zh: 内心喜乐；欢喜（忭：欢欣快乐）
entries.en: inner contentment, joy; gladness
entries.notes: M 栏 Piěn（忭）清晰，右旁另注 oor 残疑，R 栏 sïē 与字形不合，依赖词头与汉字推断。

entries.zh: 内心满足；幸得心安、称心（幸：庆幸、心里安然）
entries.en: contentment of heart; to feel fortunate, at ease within

entries.zh: 欢（欢喜）：内心快乐、喜悦
entries.en: joy, delight (huan: glad, joyful)

entries.zh: 喜：喜悦、欢喜
entries.en: joy, gladness (hi: happy, delighted)

entries.zh: 悦：喜悦、愉快
entries.en: pleasure, delight (yue: pleased, contented)
entries.notes: M 栏首字母 v/o 疑难辨，音写不定，依赖汉字「悦」与词头 Contento 推断。

entries.zh: 乐：快乐、作乐取乐
entries.en: joy, pleasure; to take delight (lok: happy)
entries.notes: R 栏仅 lō 单音，M 栏右上小字残疑；汉字「乐」与 M 栏 chǒg lǒ 可互证。

entries.zh: 欢喜：心里高兴、乐于此事（自得其乐）
entries.en: joyful, glad; to rejoice in something, to take pleasure in

entries.zh: 作乐：寻欢作乐、欢庆
entries.en: to make merry, to celebrate; rejoicing

entries.zh: 宁静：心境安宁平静、安然自得
entries.en: tranquility of mind, peace and contentment
entries.notes: M 栏首字母 t/l/n 疑难辨；汉字「宁静」与 R 栏 nēng chēng 可互证，音写依赖推断。

entries.zh: 安分：安守本分、知足心安
entries.en: content with one's lot, to keep within one's station

entries.zh: 安本分：安于本分、心平气和无所希求
entries.en: to rest content in one's proper station, quietly resigned

entries.zh: 本分：分内之事、安于自身境遇
entries.en: one's proper duty or lot; contentment with one's own condition

entries.zh: 守分：恪守本分、安分守己
entries.en: to keep one's station, to observe one's proper lot
entries.notes: M 栏守字上有墨渍，西语词尾 ofuerſo/ofuerio 拼写存疑；汉字与音写仍可互证为「守分」。

entries.zh: 守拙：安于愚拙、不求闻达（安守本分不慕荣利）
entries.en: to keep to one's simplicity, content in humbleness (shou-zhuo)
entries.notes: 西语词形残疑（viiestad/vilestad），R 栏两音 T99 污损难辨；仅汉字「守拙」与 M 栏 siú chǔeat 大体可辨。

entries.zh: 春风：如沐春风般惬意舒畅（春风满面、心满意足）
entries.en: spring breeze; cheerful and at ease, contented (spring-wind metaphor for gladness)
entries.notes: 汉字「春风」与音写清晰，但西语 Contento, descansado（心满意足、安闲）取的是比喻义，s 处有墨渍。

entries.zh: 承：承接、继续（承续不断）
entries.en: to continue, to carry on; to receive and sustain (cheng)
entries.notes: R 栏首字母 s/z 疑难辨；汉字「承」与 M 栏 sīn 及词头 Continuar 可互证。

entries.zh: 赐：赏赐、赐予〔词头与义项不吻合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bestow, to grant (a gift from above)
entries.notes: 西语词形残疑且与「賜」（赐给）语义不合，R 栏声调符 T04/T05 存疑；仅汉字与 M 栏 sû 可辨。
